text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweeping around the 4th corner and into 
the homestretch!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(A battle... where I am not alone. I want 
to know what lies beyond this—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(What could be happening?! That's why... 
to prepare for that...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Unleash it! All the power I have left, 
right here—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhhhhh...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Admire Groove! Admire Groove is in 
the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove crosses the finish line in 
first...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Admire Groove! She just clenched her 
fist...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Aah... It was the absolute... best 
taste ever♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm very... satisfied—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —...Satisfied...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
No... No way...! If this keeps up, 
I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ah! Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah......!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: 1st place...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll see this through with you to the 
bitter end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't a bad final stretch. Don't 
forget that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I won...!!

Admire Groove returned, having triumphed 
in the fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Umâ

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Umm—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

A smile appeared on Air Groove's face. She 
must have sensed how Admire Groove felt.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You won. Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I saw it. All of it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well done, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: See, it's not cold anymore.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: It's not cold anymore.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: Yeah, 'cause you see—

text_block_list.name: Young Alv?
text_block_list.text: I feel so nice and warm—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That was truly a wonderful run.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list:
This victory feels different from all the 
others, huh.

This victory feels different from all the 
others, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I can't explain it very well, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —I feel the same way.

Afterward, swept up in the award ceremony, 
media interviews, and the Winning Live, we 
finally returned to pack up and head home, 
when—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That finally settles things for now. 
Needless to say for Alve herself, but――

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now all those tearful days you spent 
running around have finally paid off for 
you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ――? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Calling me to races, asking for advice 
about the Álfr... things like that, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost... Heh. Almost as if he's 
'serving' the Alfs."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. Come now, don't be so harsh on them.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, we can now think about our 
prospects for next year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do you already have things you want to do 
moving forward?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That is... true—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, not in specific terms 
just yet.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I just want to try out this 
new approach a little while longer.

This time, Admire Groove managed to reach 
a whole new dimension. She should be able 
to hold her own in any race now.
choice_data_list:
Even in Senior class, your strength will 
definitely hold up

Even in Senior class, I'm sure your 
strength will carry you through

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then should we jump into the Spring 
Senior Triple Crown right from the first 
race? It'll be a test of strength in the 
Senior Class among seasoned veterans."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I'm counting on you.

And so, having conquered the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup and achieved a spiritual 
resurgence, we set our sights together on 
the spring Osaka Hai—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Why! Why, why, why...! Why is this 
happening...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Still-san...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I have to win...! I want to deliver 
victory to "that person"...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I need more power... I need you...! Don't 
be satisfied yet...! Don't fade away...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The stronger the foes she faces, the 
bigger the race, the stronger her 
"instincts" become...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(—Her "instincts" are... fading...? Could 
she be... satisfied...?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't care what happens to my heart...! 
I'd gladly give it all to you...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —...Still-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: !? A-Alve-san...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ……Please leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I know that for you, fighting in these 
races, her "instinct" is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Having found satisfaction in battle, she 
was about to fade away. So, even if it 
meant surrendering my own body, I tried to 
hold her back—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"……Please leave me alone! If it means 
delivering victory to 'that person,' I 
will――"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
So you awaken her "instincts," disappear, 
and leave the rest for her to handle?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Stop messing around!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Among the strength that constantly 
threatened me... must have been the 
strength of Still-san's own convictions."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I poured all my power into fighting you, 
and you think you can get by using only 
half of yours?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you think things will just work out 
somehow... then you're underestimating me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can defeat me as an 
"incomplete Still in Love."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, you won't be able to dedicate 
another victory to the one you love.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that the last thing you want? If so, 
you'd better drop that stupid idea of 
disappearing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The two of you—the strongest—must continue 
to fight me from here on out.

The fierce battle between Admire Groove 
and Still in Love reached a turning point. 
And then—

With her sights set on the Senior year 
where formidable rivals gather, new days 
were about to begin—
